prompt: A vertical 9:16 candid snapshot on grainy 35mm colour film, at night, across the counter of a small British corner shop. Nobody behind it: an empty stool, a cash register drawer left open and empty, a scratchcard stand with invented unreadable cards, a radio. On the counter a small open box of unbranded purple chocolate bars, a sticker on the box reading "£5". One white loaf waits on the counter as if someone set it down and left. Above, the single working tube buzzes cold green-blue; the doorway to the back room behind the counter is pitch black. Underexposed, muddy shadows, halation, grain, soft focus. No people, no logos, not glossy. Thanks.
